summary: Add MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, Meilisearch, MinIO to Docker Compose
description:
## What to do
Extend `infra/docker-compose.yml` with MongoDB (27017), Redis (6379), RabbitMQ (5672/15672), Meilisearch (7700), and MinIO (9000/9001). KinVue depends on all of these for users, rooms, search, messaging, and media.

## Technical notes
- Service: `apps/movie-service` port 4003; DB postgresql://localhost:5434; Meilisearch http://localhost:7700
- Service: `apps/rooms-service` HTTP 4004, WS ws://localhost:4014/rooms; Redis `redis://localhost:6379`
- Service: `apps/notifications-service` port 4005; RabbitMQ amqp://localhost:5672, management UI localhost:15672
- Object storage: MinIO localhost:9000, bucket `kinvue-media`, console localhost:9001
- Labels: infra

## Story points
3

## Depends on
KIN-11

## Acceptance criteria
- `pnpm infra:up` starts all containers
- RabbitMQ UI at localhost:15672
- MinIO console at localhost:9001
- Meilisearch /health returns OK

- 27_MAIN_STEP_BY_STEP_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md

summary: [Epic] CI/CD Pipeline
description:

Automated quality gate on every PR: lint, typecheck, unit/integration tests, Playwright smoke.

## Scope
GitHub Actions workflow, Docker Compose in CI, artifact upload on failure.

## Out of scope
Do not deploy to production in this epic — CI only.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-631: GitHub Actions: install, lint, typecheck, unit tests
2. KIN-632: CI: Docker Compose integration tests + Playwright smoke
3. KIN-633: Upload test artifacts on CI failure

description:

summary: [Epic] MVP Deployment
description:
## Goal
Deploy KinVue MVP to production within <= $300/month with smoke-tested Gateway, WS, and media.

Production Dockerfiles, infra provisioning, deploy, migrations, deployment runbook.
